candidate_scope: one pinned C4 jar meridian, one native revolved B-rep, one STEP export and one STEP import
candidate_claim: native geometry and roundtrip diagnostics only; global wall, lip qualification, physics, and production readiness remain UNKNOWN

geometry_source.coordinate_encoding: exact rational strings parsed as Fraction; convert to float only when filling OCP point/array values
geometry_source.knots: open uniform u in [0,1]; knot j/12 for j=0..12

native_route.offset_sign_basis: V=+Y and OCCT 7.9.3 T.Crossed(V) gives inward (-zprime,rprime) in (r,z)
native_route.section_plane: global XZ; oriented plane normal -Y to match the outer-to-lip-to-inner-to-axis wire order

native_gates.axis_degenerate_edge: record BRepPrimAPI_MakeRevol degeneracy/history; allow the section axis edge only if the complete solid and every face pass the gates above

finite_diagnostics.method: at identical exact global-u parameters, compare the analytic 3 mm normal target from outer D1 against the native Geom_OffsetCurve value and compare tangent directions
finite_diagnostics.proof_scope: finite kernel diagnostics only; no global native B-rep Hausdorff or wall proof

step_roundtrip.required_face_role_inventory: pre-export roles come from Generated(source_edge) history with unique IsSame body-face inventory and source-derived bbox checks; post-import roles require unique native per-role bbox+area fingerprint matches, independent of face index and surface adaptor type

face_role_fingerprint.interpretation: finite metric semantic match only; does not prove full face geometry equality

step_roundtrip.type_conversion: record actual pre/post edge-curve and face-surface categories as report-only data
step_roundtrip.claim_limit: matching bounds/area/volume/role metrics do not prove full geometric equality

claim_limits.ideal_2d_meridian_curve_pair_minimum: EXACTLY_3_MM; scope is the pinned ideal curve pair only
